dayView.tourChoices: Everything you can do right now is listed here: your next class or shift, any events on, and the rest. Pick one and you go.
dayView.tourPartners: Whoever's here with you. Click someone to start a line about her in the box below, or right-click her to see what you know about her.
dayView.tourStudy: Study for a class to earn points toward your grade. Pick the course, then where to study. Somewhere quiet is better, and studying with a classmate is better still.
dayView.tourStats: Work on yourself raises your stats, one at a time. Each choice is a short game somewhere you can go right now. Play it well and it counts for more.
dayView.tourFocus: This is your focus. When you skip ahead to your next class, shift or plan, the hours in between go into whatever you set here: half of what a real session would earn, but for no energy. Set it and you never waste an hour.
dayView.tourFreeText: If what you want isn't listed, write it here. "Spar at the Tiltyard", "invite Faye to dinner". If it can be done, it will be.
dayView.tourEndDay: And when you've had enough, end the day. You sleep until morning.
dayView.tourDone: That's everything. Now go on, orientation's about to start.

miniGame.pickUp: Bring the iron to the spark
miniGame.how.strength: Hold to lift and let go inside the gold mark. Eight reps.
miniGame.how.dexterity: Pick up the spark with the iron and draw it along the wire to the lamp without straying.
miniGame.how.endurance: Tap to push your pace and keep the needle in the green.
miniGame.how.intelligence: Click tiles to turn them until the spark reaches the lamp.
miniGame.how.wisdom: Watch the candles flare, then light them in the same order. Each round adds one, and a wrong candle ends it.
miniGame.how.charisma: Answer each face before she loses patience: compliment her if she's happy, joke if she's bored, comfort her if she's sad, give her space if she's annoyed.

courses.tourSkill: See that? Get your marks high enough in a class and it teaches you something you can actually use. Worth more than the grade, if you ask me.
courses.tourSearch: After someone in particular? Put her name in here and it shows you every class she's in. Don't look at me like that. I know why you're asking.
courses.tourHelp: Too lazy to do it yourself? Hit this, tell it what you're after, and it'll pick the lot for you. Can't say I'm surprised.
